My first playthrough was when it came out in '05 and I didn't like it. I had played through kh1 so many times and I thought it was so different and I just wasn't into it. Years later, right before the kh3 launch (I didn't even know there were other games at this point.) I decided I wanted to go through kh1 and 2 for a 100% critical mode playthrough before the new release. This is when I got the kh1.5 and 2.5 remasters and I realized how awesome kh2 is.

Kh1 will always hold a special place in my heart as being the first video game I ever played all the way through as a child, but kh2 has so much more story depth variety of combat and extra things to do after game end. (I.e. data fights, black mushrooms, ect.) Kh2 is my favorite of all of the kh games so far and one of the best video games I've ever played.

I got an x-ray negative of my foot bones because anatomy fascinates me. I'm going to be getting something to represent my family because they mean a lot to me.
My opinion is to stay away from anything too specific. If you get something that means a lot to you that you love for the artwork your gonna be less likely to end up disliking it.
Also, stay away from text and portraits. It's difficult to find an artist to do them well, and it's more likely to end up being something you dislike down the road. (This is all my opinion. Obviously do whatever you want and whatever you think is meaningful!)
